item.title: Press Release: GOAL’s first batch of doctoral graduates conferred through TAU
item.description: Thirty-three (33) GOAL scholars have completed their doctoral degrees through Texila American University (TAU) in Guyana. This is the first group of GOAL scholars to earn PhDs. item.title: Press Release: Over 14,000 awarded GOAL scholarships in 2026
item.description: A total of 14,064 citizens have been awarded scholarships through the Guyana Online Academy of Learning (GOAL) for 2026, bringing the number of scholarships awarded between 2021 and 2026 to 54,627.
